answer: The first thing to break is jury independence. Three graders per submission, scores compared, and any pair differing by more than one point sends the case to a second panel. When that panel fails to agree the failure is published with address and reason, and the pearl of a clean record is gone. Slashing follows the delta, not the verdict, so a farm cannot grade its own clones without appearing on that list, and the crystal it staked is gone before the appeal window opens.
